output.patientMessage: A Counsel clinician can review this in the thread and discuss your options — including lifestyle measures, non-hormonal medicines and hormone therapy — since choosing treatment depends on your medical history. Meanwhile, layered clothing, a cool bedroom and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods may help. Contact a clinician promptly if you develop heavy or unusually prolonged bleeding, bleeding after sex, or chest pain.
